details: US banking groups have voiced concerns that several federal agencies are advancing stablecoin regulations too quickly, arguing it complicates understanding how new rules interact with existing ones. They are advocating for a more coordinated approach for clarity and consistency. However, the White House has reportedly intervened, signaling strong executive support for the legislation to proceed without further delay from the banking lobby. FinCEN and OFAC have also proposed Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and sanctions rules for stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act.
sourceName: CoinDesk (as cited by Binance News and Crypto News)
sourceUrl: Not provided in the source text (Cited from CoinDesk)
title: US Banking Groups Criticize Rapid Stablecoin Regulation, White House Pushes Forward

details: Ethereum is experiencing significant institutional inflows into U.S. Spot Ethereum ETFs, with total net assets under management surpassing $13.6 billion. A leveraged Ether ETF (ETHU) also attracted $11.2 million in new money on April 21, 2026, indicating renewed investor interest. Technical analysts are drawing parallels to Netflix's historical breakout pattern, suggesting Ethereum could reach a bullish target of $4,300 by late Q2 or early Q3 2026. Ethereum's price has risen by 3.50% in the last 24 hours, trading around $2,391.26.
title: Ethereum ETF Inflows Surge, Hinting at Potential $4,300 Price Target

details: Bitcoin has decisively broken above $78,000, reaching levels not seen since February, with some reports indicating it briefly cleared $79,000. This surge is attributed to a short squeeze, triggering $286 million in market-wide short liquidations. Improved geopolitical sentiment following the extension of the US-Iran ceasefire and renewed derivatives demand also contributed to the rally. On-chain analytics suggest the bear market is over, and institutional investors are betting on a fresh Bitcoin rally, with BlackRock's IBIT purchasing over $1.6 billion in BTC in the past 10 days.
title: Bitcoin Surges Past $78,000 Amid Short Squeeze and Geopolitical Calm

details: Tether's USDT supply has reached a new all-time high of 188 billion, as confirmed by CEO Paolo Ardoino. This milestone highlights the increasing demand for the stablecoin, which is widely utilized in cryptocurrency trading and as a digital dollar equivalent. The continuous growth in USDT supply reflects its sustained adoption across various platforms and markets.
title: Tether's USDT Supply Hits Record High of 188 Billion
